a: Workflows in .github/workflows/*.yml define automated CI/CD on GitHub events.
on: push, pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch are common triggers.
Jobs run on runners; steps inside a job share a workspace.
actions/cache speeds installs by reusing dependencies between runs.
Store tokens in repo/org secrets; never commit them.
strategy.matrix tests multiple versions/OS in parallel.
upload-artifact shares build outputs between jobs or for download.
Pre-commit hooks run linters/tests before a commit is created.
CI can enforce conventional commit messages for changelogs.
Branch protection requires reviews and green checks before merge.
Dependabot opens PRs to update vulnerable or outdated dependencies.
Fail fast stops the pipeline early when critical checks fail.
